card.name: Dosing interval after 'every N'
card.fires_on: The word 'weeks' (or the space before the number) right after 'every' plus a number in injection schedules, where a maintenance interval is being given. Also fires on 'by' after 'followed' and on 'periodically'.

modes.label: Every N weeks
modes.description: The unit 'weeks' after 'every' and a number in a maintenance dosing schedule.
modes.example: 300 mg by subcutaneous injection at Weeks 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 and every 4<< weeks>> thereafter.

modes.label: Gap before interval number
modes.description: The space token after 'every' or 'increased to', just before the interval number.
